newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber prices mixed in weak trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber prices mixed in weak trade.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were mixed at midday in weak trading, following a lower futures market in Tokyo.

At noon, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted market indicator price for November RSS 1 buyer at 309 cents ($1.24) a kg, down a half cent from Monday's close. November SMR 20 buyer was unchanged at 306.
Trading houses offered the SMR 20 at 303-304 cents a kg, SMR10 at 304-305, SMR 5 at 316, SMR L at 342, SMR CV at 362 and drum latex at 232 to 234 cents.
"Interest is still lacking and it's uncertain what's keeping the buyers," said a dealer, who could not report any enquiries.
Traders said the wet weather, which had prevailed from last week, had reduced rubber tapping activities and tightened supply of raw materials but buyers had not reacted to these.
"The way the market is being supressed, it's going to shoot up too fast and too high once demand returns," said another dealer.
